title: Product LANEIGE Glaze Craze France
fullIngredientsList: Alcohol Denat., Parfum/Fragrance, Propylene Glycol, Aqua/Water/Eau, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Limonene, Linalool, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Benzyl Salicylate, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Citronellol, Hydroxycitronellal, Citral, Geraniol, Coumarin, Hexyl Cinnamal, Farnesol, Alcohol, Tris(Tetramethylhydroxypiperidinol) Citrate, Methyl 2-Octynoate, Benzyl Benzoate, Yellow 6 (CI 15985), Red 33 (CI 17200), Red 4 (CI 14700).
description:
Quench parched skin with The Ordinarys Natural Moisturising Factors + HA, a lightweight cream that uses skin-identical ingredients to replenish lost moisture and visibly strengthen the skin.

A potent blend of amino acids, fatty acids and ceramides helps to soften and smooth, while sodium PCA and hyaluronic acid lock in lasting hydration to leave skin feeling supple, refreshed and naturally glowing.
howToUse:
☼ AM / ☽ PM​
When to Use: ​After cleansing and serums.
Application:​ Apply to the face and neck.
Routine: Follow with SPF in the mornings.
ingredientBenefits:
Amino Acids: Organic molecules used in skincare to visibly firm and smooth
Fatty Acids: Helps create natural oil barrier for hydrated, plumper-looking skin
Ceramides: Long-chain lipids that work to lock in moisture
Sodium PCA: Locks in moisture to hydrate the skin
Hyaluronic Acid: A humectant that supports long-lasting hydration
